import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    counter = 1
    res = 0
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            counter += 1
        else:
            if counter % 2 == 0:
                res += 1
                counter = 1
            else:
                counter = 1
    if counter > 1:
        if counter % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
